messages:
deploybot: WARNING: staging publish failed for repo 'services/service-x' - pushed tag appears truncated. observed tag="service-x-20250315", expected full tag like "service-x-20250315-abcd1234". provenance annotation missing. auto-hold=true, reason=provenance-mismatch (logs: https://ci.internal/logs/abcd)

sara-eng: ugh, saw 3/5 canary pulls 502/manifest not found. is this the CI change that removed buildid?

jenna-ci: yes, I rolled out a tag-format change in nightly job to shorten tags. totally my bad — I didn't realize attestation step relied on the full tag. reverting now.

omar-sre: let's not hotfix in prod. pin staging back to previous digest and rollback canary. change window is open for 45m. anyone object?

mike-release: agree with pin+rollback. we also need to capture this in the release notes and create a follow-up to prevent silent tag-format changes.

deploybot: ACTION: created pin revert -> service-x pinned to sha256:abcd1234prev (requested by omar-sre). Canary rollback scheduled in 2m. (deploybot run id: run-20250315-77)

sara-eng: quick verify command I ran: `aws ecr batch-get-image --repository-name services/service-x --image-ids imageTag=service-x-20250315` -> returns manifest but no cosign annotations. so publish likely skipped attestation.

jenna-ci: re-running CI with old tag scheme and attestation step reenabled. pushing new image with full tag now. ETA ~12m.

omar-sre: I've manually set a hold on autopromote in the release config: `promote.enabled=false` until jenna confirms. also logged incident INC-1234 and added rollback playbook snippet.

mike-release: draft note: "Staging publish interrupted due to a tag-format change that stripped build id and prevented provenance attestation. Staging pinned to previous digest; CI fix pending."

jenna-ci: pushed new image -> `service-x-20250315-abcd1234`. cosign verify output: `Signature verified for sha256:abcd1234` (see https://ci.internal/artifacts/service-x/abcd1234).

deploybot: NOTICE: canary resume requested by jenna-ci. resuming canary monitoring for 5m. will alert on regressions.

omar-sre: monitoring metrics: pulls success back to normal, no manifest errors. :thumbsup: I'm removing manual hold now and closing INC-1234 once release notes added.

sara-eng: nice. follow-up item: add a CI gate that fails if tag format changes without explicit approval, and add a unit test for attestation step.

mike-release: creating a short postmortem doc and adding to release notes. thanks all. :coffee:
